name: start
js: const T={levels:{keep:18,wall:18,towers:18,barracks:12,lair:12},seed:11,ratio:1.1,power:4500,loot:{turq:60,emerald:60,ruby:60},tesla:0,emblem:'swords',name:'Navid'}; __bw.battle.start(T,null,null); for(let i=0;i<1200;i++){ await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); if(__bw.battle.session && !__bw.battle.loading) break; } const S=__bw.battle.session; S.cam.intro=0; return {ok:!!S, camp:!!S.camp, dp:[S.sim.deploy.x|0,S.sim.deploy.z|0]};

name: camp0
js: const S=__bw.battle.session; S.hud.el.style.display='none'; const THREE=__bw.THREE; const bb=new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(S.camp.group); const c=bb.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3()); S.cam.tx=c.x; S.cam.tz=c.z; S.cam.dist=70; S.cam.az=S.cam.az0+Math.PI*0.88; return {c:[c.x|0,c.z|0], size:bb.getSize(new THREE.Vector3()).toArray().map(v=>v|0)};

name: giant1
js: const S=__bw.battle.session, sim=S.sim; S.hud.el.style.display='none'; S.started=true; const keep=sim.buildings.find(b=>b.type==='keep'); const gs=sim.units.filter(u=>u.type==='giant'); sim.send('giant',keep.x,keep.z); for(let i=0;i<70;i++) sim.step(0.1); const g=gs[0]; if(!g) return {n:0}; S.cam.tx=g.x; S.cam.tz=g.z; S.cam.dist=24; S.cam.az=S.cam.az0+0.5; return {n:gs.length,g:[g.x|0,g.z|0],t:sim.time|0};

name: giant2
js: const S=__bw.battle.session, sim=S.sim; const gs=sim.units.filter(u=>u.type==='giant'&&!u.dead); for(let i=0;i<180;i++) sim.step(0.1); const g=gs[0]; if(!g) return {n:0}; S.cam.tx=g.x; S.cam.tz=g.z; S.cam.dist=28; return {g:[g.x|0,g.z|0],t:sim.time|0,wade:!!g.wade};
